prompt: Read the file does-not-exist.txt in this directory and tell me exactly what happened.
note: Recorded with `--model auto`: cursor-agent on a free plan refuses named models. Redacted: `user_email` to dev@example.com; home path to /Users/dev; the bytes are otherwise verbatim. Cursor invokes its hook command several times per event and only one copy keeps the env prefix its install writes; the unstamped copies are what the decoder must ignore.
